situation: Old mates from uni in a group chat.
topic: Going over a night when they were absolutely wrecked: blackouts, one of them wetting themselves, a fight outside a kebab shop, and plans to do it all again Friday.

text: Does anyone still have the receipt from that kebab shop. The night we got chucked out of the taxi
Why would you want that
For friday need proof it actually happened
It happened. I still have the graze on my knee
Chips were £4.50 I remember that
NATHAN
What
Dont have it sorry. Might be in a coat somewhere
Someone also has to tell me who was in the back of the taxi with the window down. I genuinely cant remember that part
Was it nate

No
it was not
It was nate
I was in the front
The driver was not happy
He stopped at the lights and just looked at us for ages
Im in on friday. Where are we starting
Same place obvs. We can't go back to the other one after the thing with the bouncer
Which thing
You know which thing
Ok I'm not doing the taxi home with 3 of you again. I'm getting the early one
I'm serious, I have a 9am client friday morning and I can't be looking like that
I'm on till 11 tomorrow so I'll meet you after. 12ish
Nath can you not be a bartender on a friday for once 😭
Can't. They pay me to be there
I'll get the taxi with whoever's still standing
So me then
Ok split it three ways when we're leaving, not four. Nate can go with tom
Why am I always the one who gets split up
Because of the knee thing
Still no receipt btw
Catrin go to bed
Ur not my dad
Just got in. Where are you
Client at 9. Im going to look like a normal person at 9. Watch me
Ur always normal the morning after. Thats ur whole thing
Im not hungover today thats the whole point
Year 3 just tried to play Twinkle Twinkle on a recorder with a satsuma in it. Dont ask
Ask
No
Woman just came in asking for something to stop hiccups. I cant help with that. She was v serious about it tho
Hold your breath and drink from the wrong side of the glass
Thats not a pharmacy thing nate
Dead in here. One bloke and a dog that keeps looking at me like I owe it money
Did you ask it to order
Its a dog tom
Client loved the drawings. I did a small dance in the stairwell, nobody saw
Ffion dancing in a stairwell is my favourite thing that's ever happened
Ok so I rang the kebab place. Guy said they dont keep receipts from that long ago. He also said "is this about the taxi" so they remember us
Well that's a yes then
Got a cello through the car door today. Actually through. Door fine, cello fine. Im not fine
Did it survive
Yeah. I didnt
Leaving in 20. Still the place on queen st?
Still the place. Dont order the thing
What thing
You know which thing
Omg nathan
Last orders. Going to be late, sorry. 12ish still
Its fine we're already on the second drink ur fine
Taxi's here. Early one. Dont let Catrin near a kebab shop
I have no idea what ffion is talking about
Home. Shoes off. Dont text me
Back booth. Catrin is explaining the bouncer to a plant
Is it the one from the other place
ITS NOT A PLANT ITS A FERN
Taxi booked for 2:10. Catrin nate you're in it. I'll walk
No ur getting in tom
I live 10 mins away
Taxi's here. Catrin sit in the front
Im sitting in the back with the window down and ur not my dad
Oh no
Ok who got home. Tom did u walk
Walked. 25 mins. Didn't stop at the bins this time
Got in at 2:40. Driver knew my name by the end. Don't ask how
Ask
No
I'm normal. I'm up. I'm making eggs like a grown woman
Ffion hasn't had a hangover since 2016 I don't believe it
I just stopped mentioning them
[photo: my fern, back in its pot. It's fine]
Very healthy
It's a fern
Nate did you leave your keys in the taxi or is that just me
Found them. In my shoe. No idea how
Same as last time
Anyone going to the Sunday thing at Hannah's or is that just me and the wine
Kid asked me if the recorder had been to prison. I said no. He said it looks like it has
Honestly fair
On at 4. Saturday bar is worse than Friday, don't come in anyone
Wasn't planning to
Ramen place on working st has reopened. Think it's the one
The one where they put the egg in the wrong place last time
They fixed it. It's fine
Are we doing next friday or are we done for the year
Done for the year obvs. Christmas
I'm not doing the taxi again
Ffion said that last week
I meant it last week too
Last one in the bar tonight wanted a pint of water in a wine glass. Asked me to make it look like wine. I did
Ur an artist
It was £3.80 for the water and the glass
Coming out or home with a film
Film. Ffion u in
Yeah ok. Not going out. Film. Pyjamas
Ffion in pyjamas is my second favourite thing that's ever happened
Nathan ur finished?
Just locking up. Don't start on the kebab
I wasn't
She was
Ok im going to bed this time
Lol
Liar
Film's off. Night. Not texting after this
Home. Don't tell Catrin the bouncer was nice to me
